scope: Venetian Bridge, two adjacent islands and bounded shore approaches; independent of Marine Way Bridge and pier.

imagery.kind: actual satellite overhead and opposing textured 3D views
imagery.observation: Two distinct elongated irregular islands; bridge runs through both. Vegetation obscures exact waterline. Captures private; imagery date not established.
Transverse decking, cream turned balusters and square piers, green columns with varied apparent lamp fittings, one side gate and central rise.
Side view shows arch over central water, flat approach spans on discrete narrow supports, and low vegetated island with rocky bank.
Central arched underside, open spandrel details, balustrade and green globe columns; image date and current fitting condition uncertain.
Side photograph shows flat outer spans supported on narrow piers, central arched span and rocky vegetated island banks.
Side photograph resolves a near-side span and piers; deck-to-water clearance approximately 1.8–2.3 railing heights, subject to perspective and lake level.
Oblique view shows narrow piers, transverse decking and mixture of globe-topped and bare green posts.

station_frame.note: One straight shore-to-shore axis, used by deck, profile, UVs, fascia, plinths and rails; island outlines retained pending sharper toe evidence.

islands.status: existing outline assessed against aerial; vegetation makes toe uncertain by several metres
existing distinct outline assessed against aerial; vegetation makes toe uncertain by several metres

limits: Deck width 5.2 +/- 0.8 m remains an aerial estimate, not surveyed clear width.
Mainland rough road interpolation at the islands rose above the bridge and is not island evidence. Island crown, bank width and height are bounded provisional massing estimates.
Underside, detailed support layout, gate locations and present-day lamp head state require additional coverage. Do not infer multiple globe fittings from the one 2023 foreground lamp.
Shared water datum is held fixed. Photographic clearance ratios informed bounded bridge and island estimates; perspective, water fluctuations, exact crown and shore grade remain uncertain.

district_budget_proposal.texture_atlas: none; fixed mesh and material budget independent of Detail fittings

ratio_evidence.interpretation: Deck-to-water about 91/48 = 1.9 rail heights at near pier; perspective and water level uncorrected, estimate 1.8–2.3.
Central deck rises approximately one rail height above its flanking approaches; sloped rail follows deck, arch intrados curves separately.

structure_estimates.note: Estimated massing from the referenced photos; deck joints, pier count and bank profiles remain to be reviewed.

shore_connections.kings_gardens: A bounded grade blends the deck endpoint to the surrounding rough grid; no lake-level edit.
shore_connections.princes_park: A separately owned lower lakeside path crosses the deck near station 151; inferred 11 risers link it to a single photographed green side gate. Location and grade are provisional.

alignment_review.observation: The retained overhead and oblique references show a straight deck, with transverse boards reaching the longitudinal rail/plinth line. The previously used six-point floor polyline diverged from the straight elevation and fitting axis by up to 0.63 m.
alignment_review.decision: Keep the original endpoints and the estimated 5.2 m overall width. Use one rectangle and straight station frame; place the 0.45 m pier cap flush to its outside edge, with base rail on the deck and plinth base following profile breaks. Continue the rails to end piers and align the shore gate and stairs.
alignment_review.approach: The Kings Gardens shore wall follows the existing bounded landing profile instead of the unmodified rough grid; the bridge surface and lower path remain independent.
alignment_review.limits: Widths, station placement, pier spacing, approach levels and green railing transitions remain visual estimates, not measured as-built dimensions.

island_fittings_review.observation: The oblique view shows green open metal guardrail sections at island crossings, with multiple globe-topped and some bare green standards. The model uses estimated green sections at stations 45.19–64.81 and 95.19–114.81 m, retaining open cream balustrades elsewhere.
island_fittings_review.lights: Several identifiable globes in the first-island view are shown at estimated station locations. The separately observed side-mounted globe in the dated 2023 view is retained; this is a representative combination of dated and undated evidence, not a claim of exact simultaneous lamp condition.
island_fittings_review.limits: Precise section ends, post spacings, individual heads and any additional island gates are unresolved. No island paths or detailed terrain are inferred from the photograph.
